Implemented scripts/measure_pipeline_capacity.py and 145 tests. The tool runs the production candidate, inventory, release, restoration and split path on synthetic populations, predicts each size gate's capacity with a phase-aware size model, and confirms the first limit against production.

Model the repeating cycle of a mix with measured offsets so the size prediction is exact at every count, and treat limits within one row as tied.

Report that a split-only transport adds at most 17% of capacity and that the next L2 plan must also cover candidate lineage, the source bound, once-per-population validation and a linear-time derivation.
